title: Typical worker's hourly compensation index (1948 Q1 = 100)
cap: EPI, Productivity–Pay Gap, updated 14 Sep 2026: average hourly compensation (wages + benefits) of private production/nonsupervisory workers, same CPI deflator; points are 1948 Q1, 1973 Q1, 1979 Q1, 2000 Q1, 2020 Q1, 2026 Q2. Plot with ad4_productivity_index.
